title: Cycle 5 Explorer
idiom: Sonia Delaunay-like gouache colour disc, a turnable ring with a seven-segment window
hero_prompt: Gouache and cut-paper painting in the manner of Sonia Delaunay's colour discs, flat opaque colour, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and cut paper-edge texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: on a cream drafting sheet lies one large round disc pinned at its centre with a small brass pin, divided into twelve equal pie slices by thin cream lines, like a cake cut into twelve; seven neighbouring slices side by side are painted in bright colour, running around the disc from sunny yellow through orange and rose to deep indigo, a bright fan covering a little more than half the disc, and the other five slices are painted flat black, hatched with fine diagonal lines. A thin cream ring runs round the disc's edge. A faint ruled straight line runs the full width behind the disc. Yellow, rose, indigo, black and cream.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading or gradients: an open arc of seven separate thick solid black blocks set side by side along a circle with narrow gaps between them, the arc running over the top and down both sides, covering a little more than half the circle, and the whole bottom of the circle left completely empty, a wide open gap; one solid black dot at the centre. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
